behaviour: EventRecorder::record is the only writer of v_activity/v_outbox rows for domain events; it requires transactionLevel>0, writes activity then outbox through VaulterDatabase::insertOnce, and dispatches the Laravel event after commit (listener failure -> report() + vaulter_event_listener_failures_total).
A sink failure propagates and rolls the mutation back (C05); duplicate occurrence -> no-op; partial occurrence -> LogicException.
Feature flags are read at record time (activity/webhooks), not at boot.
Outbox payload = EventEnvelope (thin data; names only in activity context).
